plan.description: 搜索桌面及用户目录下的resume.docx文件，找到文件位置

args.code:
import subprocess
import sys
# 获取搜索结果，假设第一个匹配的就是目标文件
result = subprocess.run(['dir', '/s', '/b', 'C:\\Users\\hp\\*.docx'], capture_output=True, text=True, shell=True)
files = [f.strip() for f in result.stdout.split('\n') if f.strip()]
resume_path = None
for f in files:
    if 'resume.docx' in f.lower():
        resume_path = f
        break
if not resume_path:
    print('Error: resume.docx not found')
    sys.exit(1)
print(f'Found: {resume_path}')
# 转换
import win32com.client as win32
word = win32.Dispatch('Word.Application')
doc = word.Documents.Open(resume_path)
pdf_path = resume_path.replace('.docx', '.pdf')
doc.SaveAs(pdf_path, FileFormat=17)  # 17 = wdFormatPDF
doc.Close()
word.Quit()
print(f'PDF saved to: {pdf_path}')

plan.description: 使用win32com调用Word打开resume.docx并另存为PDF格式
将生成的PDF文件复制到输出目录（可选），并确认文件已生成
